traits.name: Mist Vision
traits.text: Fog and mist don't impair a sky dragon's vision; they ignore the concealed condition from fog and mist.

traits.name: Breath Weapon
traits.text: ⬺ (divine, electricity, evocation); The dragon shoots a ball of electricity that deals 5d12 (5d12) electricity damage in a 20-foot burst within 40 feet (DC 28 basic Reflex save). They can't use Breath Weapon again for 1d4 (1d4) rounds.

traits.name: Coiling Frenzy
traits.text: ⬺ The dragon makes one claw Strike and one tail Strike in either order, each against the same target. If either Strike hits, the dragon automatically Grabs the target.

traits.name: Draconic Momentum
traits.text: The dragon recharges their Breath Weapon whenever they score a critical hit with a Strike.

traits.name: Perfected Flight
traits.text: A sky dragon can hover in place without spending an action, and they automatically succeed at all Acrobatics checks to Maneuver in Flight.

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ jaws +21 (reach 10 feet); Damage 2d8+12 (2d8+12) piercing plus 1d12 (1d12) electricity

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ tail +21 (reach 20 feet); Damage 2d8+12 (2d8+12) bludgeoning plus Grab
